# Roadmap — captoo

**Verified:** 2026-09-27 @ 6c40437

## Direction
captoo's bet is GEO/AEO visibility for B2B marketing teams: daily buyer-prompt runs against AI answer engines, summarized weekly. The evidence so far says the weekly cadence under-serves the moment that actually matters to customers — a real share-of-voice drop — so the near-term direction is to close that gap with timely notice rather than to widen the product `[doc:readme]` `[interview:C1]` `[interview:C3]` `[interview:C4]`.
